About CodeIQ

Work out a hidden code using the clues from your guesses. CodeIQ is a deduction puzzle: each result gives you information to use on your next attempt. Compare the feedback carefully and eliminate possibilities as you play.

How to play

  1. Enter a guess for the hidden code.
  2. Read the feedback and compare it with your previous attempts.
  3. Use what you have learned to narrow the possibilities and solve the code.
